answer: The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 111 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. Because the timing is recorded against the beacon challenge, the canyon audit can replay the spiral history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A farm of 2239 identities would post 4708 proofs and burn roughly 41 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
